description: Discover the cabinet rule through calibration feedback, then start the belt and file every specimen into the matching drawer mouth. After START BELT, specimens and mouths remain at stable visible positions until you act. A release into the cabinet that misses a mouth, a wrong file or early seal ends the case. Release back onto the belt to cancel safely. Calibration feedback and interrupted or returned uncommitted tabs are safe corrections. The first committed failure ends the episode; later attempts cannot earn a pass. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, implementation or hidden-state access. Do not interact with unrelated, blank or browser-settings tabs. Task-created tabs may be used only through their visible controls.
